'''John Yakulevich''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[2001 DragonCon Open]] on 1 September 2001 with [[Set Your Course For Alderaan / The Ultimate Power In The Universe|SYCFA/Brangus]], according to Zafar Tejani's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2938">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-09-06-z-goes-to-dragoncon-2001d2938/ z-goes-to-dragoncon-2001], DeckTech (Zafar "Zmanthe1st" Tejani, 6 September 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-09-06-z-goes-to-dragoncon-2001d2938/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

He was tournament director of the [[2006 Florida State Championship]] on 17 June 2006 at Coliseum of Comics in Orlando ($15 entry, six games and a final confrontation), and announced that the Dagobah Regionals would be held on Sunday 9 July 2006.<ref name="pcf-10110-138989">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=138989#138989 Florida States and Dagobah Regionals], John Yakulevich (rancor34), Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (30 May 2006). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20060617234913/http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?t=10110&highlight= Internet Archive]</ref> He finished 6th at the 2008 Florida State Championship (28 June 2008) and wrote a tournament report on DeckTech.<ref name="sf-21635-311852">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=311852#p311852 tournament reports, etc], Throdo (Jonathan Murray), Star Wars CCG Players Committee Forums, forum.starwarsccg.org (2 July 2008). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261125192041/https://swccg.com/snapshots/forum/t21635.html Internet Archive]</ref><ref name="sf-22883-332133">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=332133#p332133 List of People who have Worlds Day Two Auto Bids 2008], simone89, Star Wars CCG Players Committee Forums, forum.starwarsccg.org (29 August 2008). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261125194535/https://swccg.com/snapshots/forum/t22883.html Internet Archive]</ref>
